claims.text: Many reviewers say it cuts styling time dramatically, often finishing in 10-15 minutes or halving their usual routine.
Reviewers with curly, wavy, or frizzy hair report it smooths and straightens well while leaving more volume than a flat iron.
Several users say it heats up and cools down quickly and is easy and comfortable to use.
Some reviewers find it doesn't straighten as thoroughly as a flat iron and still need an iron for roots or finishing.
A few negative reviews cite slow heating, insufficient heat for their hair type, and controls that are easy to accidentally turn off.
